reviews.title: Great cooler for the price
reviews.comment: Great cooler for the price. Was simple install compared to other coolers I've used and running cinabench for 30min on my i7 10700 never went over 70C. Sleek design and pretty quiet all things considered.
reviews.author: Adam

reviews.title: Funciona correctamente
reviews.comment: Funciona correctamente, lastimosamente no entra en mi case. Asegurense que entre en su case antes de conprarlo :p
reviews.author: Luis Larrea

reviews.title: Good product.
reviews.comment: This is a decent cooling fan. Looks pretty cool esthetically and gets the job done. Its particularly special in terms of performance but the thermals are consistent.
reviews.author: Goated buds

reviews.title: Una gran mejora para la preservación de la Pc
reviews.comment: Es robusto y de buena calidad. Tenia problemas graves con mi procesador ryzen 5 7600, y no era problema en su "fabricación", y eso creo ya que no me ha dado fallos de sistema, pero en su momento llegaba a temperaturas de 90~95 °C en condiciones de encendido o jugando al valorant, pero con este Cooler apenas llega a 70 °C.
reviews.author: David

reviews.title: W cooler
reviews.comment: I’ve had this cooler for about 9 months now, the thermal paste it came with was great, my temps stay nice and cool, it was easy to install, and it looks sick in my build. Great quality item, well worth the money.
reviews.author: Lucid
